text.p: Israeli Internet telephony firm VocalTec Ltd has changed its name to VocalTec Communications Ltd, the company said on Monday.

"Our new name -- VocalTec Communications -- reflects our strategy to lead the trend towards integrating Internet and intranet networks with public communications networks and to provide full communications solutions for transmitting media between end users," a company statement said.

VocalTec Communications develops and markets software that allows for voice and multimedia communications over the Internet and corporate intranets, as well as systems to bridge the Internet with public switched phone networks.
The company, based in Herzliya, Israel, is traded on the Nasdaq.
